# FSHD Society

> The FSHD Society empowers patients with facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy through education, research acceleration, and comprehensive living resources.

FSHD Society is a patient-centered organization dedicated to supporting individuals with FSHD (facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy) through educational content, clinical research updates, and community resources. The site offers multilingual support and features FSHD University, BetterLife FSHD, and the FSHD Navigator to help patients understand their condition and manage daily life.

## Key Topics

- FSHD (facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy)
- FSHD Type 1 and Type 2
- DUX4 gene
- Genetic testing
- Clinical trials
- Gene therapy
- FSHD University
- BetterLife FSHD
- Patient advocacy
- Disease management
- Physical health and exercise
- Mental wellness
- Early-onset FSHD
- FSHD Navigator
- Community support

## Understanding FSHD

- [Understanding FSHD](https://www.fshdsociety.org/living-with-fshd/understanding-fshd): Educational guide on facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy basics and patient education
- [Diagnosis](https://www.fshdsociety.org/living-with-fshd/understanding-fshd/diagnosis): FSHD diagnosis guide covering physical exams, genetic testing, and clinical diagnosis
- [Symptoms](https://www.fshdsociety.org/living-with-fshd/understanding-fshd/symptoms): FSHD symptoms guide covering neuromuscular disease progression and checklist
- [Genetic Cause](https://www.fshdsociety.org/living-with-fshd/understanding-fshd/genetic-cause): FSHD genetic cause guide covering FSHD Type 1/2, DUX4 gene, and D4Z4 repeat
- [Genetic Testing](https://www.fshdsociety.org/living-with-fshd/understanding-fshd/genetic-testing): FSHD genetic testing guide covering counseling, FSHD Type 1/2, and insurance coverage
- [Early-onset FSHD](https://www.fshdsociety.org/living-with-fshd/understanding-fshd/early-onset-fshd): Pediatric FSHD guide for children and families with early-onset disease information
- [Glossary of Scientific Terms](https://www.fshdsociety.org/living-with-fshd/understanding-fshd/glossary-of-scientific-terms): FSHD scientific glossary defining genetic terminology and chromosome 4 concepts

## Living & Managing FSHD

- [Living With FSHD](https://www.fshdsociety.org/living-with-fshd): Comprehensive FSHD living guide with BetterLife FSHD and FSHD University resources
- [Managing FSHD](https://www.fshdsociety.org/living-with-fshd/managing-fshd): FSHD management guide with resources for exercise, pain, breathing, and adaptive tools
- [Physical Health](https://www.fshdsociety.org/living-with-fshd/understanding-fshd/fshd-university/physical-health): FSHD physical health guide covering exercise, nutrition, and wellness resources
- [Wellness](https://www.fshdsociety.org/living-with-fshd/understanding-fshd/fshd-university/wellness): FSHD mental health and wellness guide with therapy resources and support programs

## FSHD University & Education

- [FSHD University](https://www.fshdsociety.org/living-with-fshd/understanding-fshd/fshd-university): FSHD University hub with monthly webinars, health tips, and research updates
- [Patient Library](https://www.fshdsociety.org/living-with-fshd/understanding-fshd/patient-library): FSHD patient library with resources on clinical trials, gene therapy, and research

## Community & Events

- [Events](https://www.fshdsociety.org/events): FSHD Society events and webinars covering disability rights, ADA compliance, employment
- [Blog](https://www.fshdsociety.org/blog): Blog covering FSHD research, clinical trials, drug development, and patient community

## Multilingual Resources

- [FSHD Society - Arabic](https://www.fshdsociety.org/ar): FSHD Society homepage in Arabic for patient empowerment and FSHD progress
- [FSHD Society - Spanish](https://www.fshdsociety.org/es_mx): FSHD Society homepage in Spanish for patient support and muscular dystrophy advocacy
- [FSHD Society - French](https://www.fshdsociety.org/fr): FSHD Society homepage in French for patient advocacy and clinical research support
- [FSHD Society - Chinese](https://www.fshdsociety.org/zh): FSHD Society homepage in Chinese for patient resources and research advancement

- [FSHD Society Home](https://www.fshdsociety.org): FSHD Society homepage introducing organization's mission for facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy patients
